programme.title: Drive Time Murders
programme.desc: Drama with Cameron Daddo. A handsome attorney and his gossip columnist wife who host their own radio show, and also solve murder mysteries dig into a murder of a homeless lady.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 9: Oh Baby
programme.desc: Crime drama with Kellie Martin. A couple accused of a murder go on the run, leaving their baby with bookshop owner and amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey. Can she look after the child and solve the case?

programme.title: Mystery Woman 6: Redemption
programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 10: In the Shadows
programme.desc: While searching for a KGB double agent who was about to be exposed by another Russian spy-turned-successful author, mystery bookstore owner Samantha Kinsey and her secretive friend and store manager, Philby are thrust into the murderous world of international espionage.

programme.title: Life on Liberty Street
programme.desc: Heartwarming drama with Annabeth Gish. After losing her husband and job, a single mother's life changes unexpectedly while working at a care centre for brain trauma patients.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: In 1864, an American Civil War troop struggles to survive when young Union (American Civil War) soldier Jim Rabb (Ryan Merriman) discovers that his mare has given birth to a Colt (horse). A superior officer orders Jim to shoot the foal because it may become a burden, but Jim - seeing the colt as a sign of hope and a reminder of the beauty of life - refuses. The colt remains with the men as they battle. When Confederacy (American Civil War)s overtake the camp and steal the colt, Jim must risk his life retrieving it.

programme.title: The Colour of Magic
programme.desc: Constantly failing at the Unseen University, the wizard Rincewind is given the task by the Patrician of looking after the Discworld's first tourist: Twoflower. The main character is the incompetent and cynical wizard Rincewind, who involuntarily finds himself as a guide to the naive tourist, Twoflower. After they are forced to flee from the city of Ankh-Morpork after a terrible fire they are sent on a journey across the disc which is unknowingly being controlled by a board game being played by the Gods. They meet two barbarians on their way out of morpork, Bravd and Weasel. After their visit to Wyrmberg, the upside-down mountain which is home to dragons that only exist in the imagination, their journey leads them to the country of Krull, perched on the very edge of the Discworld where they are thrown off the edge of the Disc due to the Krullian's urge to find out the gender of Great A'Tuin (the turtle which is swimming through space with four elephants resting the Disc on top).

programme.title: The Colour of Magic
programme.desc: As Rincewind is hounded across the Discworld by the Wizards of Unseen University, he is helped by Twoflower the Tourist, his luggage and Cohen the Barbarian. programme.title: Lone Rider
programme.desc: Bobby Hattaway (Lou Diamond Phillips), an honored soldier, returns home after the American Civil War to find his father's (Stacy Keach) formerly prosperous store now dangerously in debt to the town's ruthless leader, and Bobby's childhood friend, Stu Croker (Vincent Spano). Bobby will now face off against his former friend to take control from Stu.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: Across the world an unprecedented Category 6 storm descends. Violent winds, hurricane-level pressure and unprecedented "tornado alleys" develop across two continents. For years, scientists have been expounding theories - and warnings - of global-warming effects. It's disaster Code Yellow, as the "storm on steroids" is only just beginning to rend the earth.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: The warming effect is creating new regions of extreme weather, but something else is triggering it; something that when combined with record-breaking heat waves creates explosions in the sky. With time running out, discredited scientist Faith Clavell, teams up with storm chaser Tornado Tommy (Emmy nominee Randy Quaid, "Elvis") and Judith to discover the trigger.

programme.title: 10.5: Apocalypse
programme.desc: When a tsunami wipes Waikiki off the map, Dr. Hill's fears about the quake's after-effects are justified. Areas seismically quiet for centuries are awakened: Bald Mountain is engulfed in a deadly cloud of smoke and ash, boiling water rises from the earth, the Hoover Dam crumbles and Mount Rushmore explodes in a fiery burst of molten lava.

programme.title: 10.5: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Las Vegas hotels have sunken into the ground, Dr. Hill and the remaining survivors are racing to escape, Meanwhile, the massive earthquake is threatening to split North America in half and the Nuclear Power plant is right in the path.

programme.title: DC 9/11: Time of Crisis
programme.desc: Gideon Banks lost his wife Liz and son Simon in a horrific car accident some twenty years ago. At the time of the accident he was involved in something called the Neural Archiving Project - NAP for short. The technology was developed to create smart computers - transferring human engrams to computers. The company eventually gave up on the technology, but Gideon didn't. After years of quietly perfecting it, he built a small robot, from parts he stole from Concorde Robotics, where he now works. Zoe, Gideon's niece, discovers Gideon's secret, the robot contains actual neural engrams from the real Simon. She becomes worried not only about Gideon but also about the robot that sounds and acts a lot like her little cousin used to.

programme.title: A Deadly Encounter
programme.desc: Thriller. After working late one night, restaurant hostess Joanne Sanders (Laura Leighton, ʻMelrose Placeʼ) accidentally cuts up a car on the highway, which leads the other driver (Alain Goulem, ʻ18 to Lifeʼ) to stalk and harass her, determined to exact his revenge.

programme.title: Murder Among Friends
programme.desc: Isabella Delarocca is a young Italian who moves to Hollywood determined to succeed as an actress. Isabella begins to teach theater classes and when a colleague of hers is arrested for murder, she decides to investigate on her behalf because she does not believe that he is guilty.

programme.desc: Heart-warming drama about a bitter, sharp-tongued spinster, whose future looks bleakwhen she is saddled with raising her nephew and niece after her sister commits suicide. Audrey resents that her family has robbed her of a life of her own, but when her childhood sweetheart reappears on the scene, her life takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 5: Game Time
programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: Claire
programme.desc: Loosely based on a Japanese fairytale, an elderly male couple on a farm in the 1920's South find a little girl from the moon inside an ear of corn and raise her as their own.

programme.title: An Unexpected Love
programme.desc: An unhappily married housewife and mother of two children (Leslie Hope) seperates from her husband and gets a new job where she developes a mutual attraction to her female boss (Wendy Crewson).

programme.title: Mark Twain's Roughing It
programme.desc: Two-part drama with Robin Dunne. Ageing writer Mark Twain recalls the time he spent as a teenager seeking his fortune in the American West during the Gold Rush years.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: Blackbeard
programme.desc: Action-packed historical drama starring Angus Macfadyen as the fearsome English pirate of the early 18th century known as Blackbeard. Lieutenant Robert Maynard is sent from Great Britain to the seas surrounding the West Indies. His mission is to destroy an infamous pirate ship, known as The Queen Anne's Revenge, and to put an end to its villainous crew including the ill-famed Blackbeard. Also starring Mark Umbers and Jessica Chastain.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
programme.desc: Negan's actions unravel alliances as the community is forced to choose a side. As the countdown towards Negan's fate begins, Maggie races against time to save him — and the community she worked hard to build.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: A Holocaust survivor heads for America where she dreams of starting a new life, but finds it difficult to put the past behind her, especially when she's forced to relive the nightmare of Auschwitz.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

programme.title: Arthur Hailey's: Detective
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Malcolm Ainslie, a Catholic priest turned distinguished investigator for the police, has agreed to hear the confession of a convicted serial killer sentenced to death in a just a matter of hours. What he promises to reveal to Ainslie is the truth behind the crimes and the reason he confessed to the one crime Ainslie doesn't even believe he committed. What unfolds between the two men is a serpentine trail into both men's pasts based on the bestseller from master storyteller Arthur Hailey.

programme.title: Just Desserts
programme.desc: Passionate Italian baker Marco Poloni enters a baking competition entitled "The Golden Whisk" to attract publicity and win prize money to support his struggling family-owned bakery in the Bronx. He asks for the help of uptight Manhattan-based pastry-maker Grace Carpenter. The unlikely pair must win to pursue their dreams and to show up an old rival of Poloni's who has also entered the competition. Along the way Marco and Grace seem to find a mutual attraction for each other.

programme.title: Deadly Isolation
programme.desc: Crafty Patrick Carlson and his violent accomplice Kyle Mumford have hidden in the woods up north for months after pulling off a major diamonds robbery in San Fracisco. programme.title: Acceptance
programme.desc: Paul confesses his feelings to Rosanna. He gets Rosanna to admit to her feelings for him but she insists she cant think about anything but Cabots welfare for now. She agrees to leave the door open between them. Meanwhile, Barbara goes to James to let him know that his plan for Jordan and Rosanna is falling apart. She indirectly asks James for his help in making sure Jordan and Rosanna stay together. Soon after, Cabot mysteriously appears in the middle of Fairwinds, when neither Paul nor Rosanna put him there! A new clue appears in the paper and Chris, Alison, Emily and Susan are all trying to figure it out. When Nancy cant help, Alison goes to Aaron. He agrees to help her, and Alison doesnt tell him about her engagement. Meanwhile, Bob helps Chris with the clue. Chris hurries to the dance studio where the key is apparently hidden and finds a tango lesson underway. Emily and Chris agree to take a tango lesson in order to get to the key. They are dancing together when Alison and Aaron arrive outside. Alison is about to go in when Aaron notices her ring. Tom confronts Margo about the compact and she tells him its not hers. Tom asks her one more time if it was only a kiss between her and Doc. Margo confirms the lie and they agree to try to move on. Jill has overheard everything. She confronts Margo after Tom leaves, promising to keep quiet about what she has witnessed on one condition. Meanwhile, Ben tells Jessica hell agree to in Vitro. At the hospital, Jessica bumps into Doc and admits shes been too hard on him. Then Dr. Schilling informs her she isnt a candidate for in vitro because shes already pregnant! Doc looks on as Ben hugs Jessica to celebrate the good news.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 7: At First Sight
programme.desc: After dating hot doctor Ben, "Mystery Woman" Samantha becomes curious about her family medical history so she sets out upstate to fictitious small town; Whiptail, California in search of her birth mother. Samantha finds her unfortunately she has just been arrested as a suspect in a murder. Murder and mystery follow Samantha wherever she goes.

programme.title: The Outsider
programme.desc: An investigation of a dead daughter begins when a military contractor Lex Walker (Craig Fairbrass) arrives in Los Angeles and he finds the body is not his daughter's. Lex Walker, a British mercenary battling in Afghanistan who drops everything to hurry to Los Angeles when he is informed that his daughter Samantha, who he has not seen in many years, has been found dead. When he arrives at the morgue to identify the body, he is for some reason unsurprised to discover that it is not hers. So he begins a one-man investigation into her whereabouts, trailed by the suspicious detective (Jason Patric) assigned to the case. He soon makes his way to Samantha's boss, Karl Schuster (James Caan), the millionaire CEO of a high-tech company who offers sympathy but little help. It quickly becomes obvious that Schuster is hiding something, since he displays no hesitation about shooting one of his henchmen to death in his own office. Aided by a sexy barmaid (Shannon Elizabeth) enticed by his offer of a $10,000 finder's fee, the take-no-prisoners Lex sets out getting to the bottom of the mystery, beating up or shooting the myriad human obstacles who get in his way. It all leads to his discovery of a massive identity-theft scheme engineered by Schuster about which Lex's very much alive daughter (Melissa Ordway) has the goods.

programme.title: Category 6: Day of Destruction
programme.desc: Three tornadoes converge to wreak havoc on Chicago, disrupting the power grid and creating the worst super-storm in history.

programme.title: Category 6: Day of Destruction
programme.desc: Three tornadoes converge to wreak havoc on Chicago, disrupting the power grid and creating the worst super-storm in history.

programme.title: For One Night
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of an African American teenager who shook up a small town where high school proms had been racially segregated for decades. Amid the protests of the community and with the help of a newspaper reporter who returns to her hometown to cover the story, the two women are able to reverse decades of racist tradition and make history, at least for one night. The movie is based on events that occurred in Taylor County, Georgia in 2002.

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: Drama with Julie Benz. After being abandoned by her husband and left with a young daughter, a woman decides to rebuild her life by entering an equestrian competition.

programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. In 1922 Cairo, free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the ultimate power to control the world. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.title: Falling in Love with the Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Bridget Connolly (Patty Duke) and Betsy Lucas (Shelley Long) are two social climbing society women from Santa Catalina Island, California who have been continuous rivals for some unknown reason. But when Betsy's son Mark falls in love with the girl next door—who happens to be Bridget's daughter Theresa—the two women put all of their energy in to planning the wedding, much to the chagrin of their children.

programme.title: Where There's a Will
programme.desc: A hapless grifter stands to inherit a small fortune from his estranged grandmother if he travels to Harmony, Texas to live with her. Instead of a short road to easy money, he finds a soft spot in his heart for the little town and unconditional love from his only living relative.

programme.title: Two Fathers: Justice for the Innocent
programme.desc: Two fathers from very different backgrounds reunite after eight years to pursue the escaped drug dealer responsible for the deaths of their son and daughter.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

programme.title: Due East
programme.desc: A smart, hardworking high school senior has been an outsider for almost 4 years. When a fellow loner moves to Due East, she finds herself in a relationship for the first time, leading to a small town scandal that changes her life forever.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: Across the world an unprecedented Category 6 storm descends. Violent winds, hurricane-level pressure and unprecedented "tornado alleys" develop across two continents. For years, scientists have been expounding theories - and warnings - of global-warming effects. It's disaster Code Yellow, as the "storm on steroids" is only just beginning to rend the earth.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: The warming effect is creating new regions of extreme weather, but something else is triggering it; something that when combined with record-breaking heat waves creates explosions in the sky. With time running out, discredited scientist Faith Clavell, teams up with storm chaser Tornado Tommy (Emmy nominee Randy Quaid, "Elvis") and Judith to discover the trigger.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Baskonia" - "Besiktas"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Stambulo „Fenerbahçe“ - Kauno „Žalgiris“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. programme.title: Battle Of the Swamp Dragons
programme.desc: South Florida is the only place on Earth that is home to both the American alligator and the American crocodile (and most recently, the Nile crocodile). But who is the baddest Florida predator? In this croc vs. gator fest, we'll compare the physical characteristics and behavior of these two prehistoric titans in the beautiful backdrop of South Florida to find out who is the true Lord of the Swamp… and identify one species that may threaten his throne.

programme.title: Cave Crocs of Gabon
programme.desc: A caving expedition recently discovered a community of dwarf crocodiles living in the Abanda Caves, Gabon. The crocs are living in pitch darkness, hunt bats and some have bright-orange skin. Part of the original team returns to find out more about this bizarre phenomenon. It's mission impossible to access the crocs world and there's no way of knowing what they might find.

programme.title: Jaguars vs. Crocs
programme.desc: Veteran wildlife photographer Steve Winter and cameraman Bertie Gregory capture the remarkable lives of Jaguars in the Pantanal of Brazil. A mother jaguar teaches her cub survival while a determined male jaguar named Scarface dives headfirst into the river to tackle the deadliest of opponents - 6-foot long caiman. programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's winter on the farm, and the Pol's are adding to their flock! The family is bringing in four merino ewes that were recently bred, which means with any luck the farm could be expecting its first lambs come springtime. And as winter fades into spring, the Pol's prepare for the new arrivals by building a lambing pen. Meanwhile, Beth checks if her bees survived the winter.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa is a land sculpted by time where animals have evolved complex weapons to arm them in the battle to live another day. An elephant's tusks can defend, or attack. An octopus uses camouflage to find food, or hide from an enemy. A Cape Fur Seal's speed and agility are valuable tools to catch a penguin, but ineffectual against a Great White Shark. A single hippopotamus holds a pride of twelve lions at bay with his sheer bulk, but backs down when faced with the piercing teeth of another hippo. With lethal weapons wielded by fearsome predators and prey, animals walk a precarious path, here among Africa's Deadliest.

programme.title: Nicobar Islands: A Monkey's Long Tale
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. The Nicobar Islands were significantly impacted by the massive tsunami of 2004. This documentary is a compelling exploration of nature's ability to adapt to millions of years of gradual tectonic change.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa's Deadliest Assassins is a tantalizing exhibition of the continents top ten deadliest killers, from the microscopic to the massive all forged in the most challenging of environments. Discover the terminators that have fought their way to the top of the food chain by evolving the meanest, biggest and most lethal of weaponry. From the terrifying jaws of the great white to the hammer like foot of the secretary bird and the toxic sting of the Wahlberg's burrowing scorpion prepare yourself to delve into the secret world of Africa's Deadliest Assassins.

These specialized agents, armed to the teeth, have cunning strategies they deploy to dominate their every environment from the forests of Gabon to the Ethiopian highlands and even the frigid Atlantic Ocean. Peer through the eyes of an insider and unearth the terrifying secrets and surprising intelligence that each of these invaders keenly combine to become the meanest, biggest and most effective killers. From the strategic acumen of chimpanzees to the ruthless brutality of spotted hyenas and the streamlined teamwork of hunting orcas prepare yourself to be immersed into the tantalizing world of Africa's Deadliest Invaders.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa's Deadliest Ambush Hunters is an awe-inspiring ride through a world of camouflage, patience, and precision. We follow these stealthy predators as they make use of their environments and special skill sets to avoid detection until the very last second. Lying in wait across the continent, from the lush Serengeti to the desert of Namibia, ambush predators are poised for action. Follow the lethal stonefish as he waits for his prey, and the most venomous cobra in Africa as he sneaks into a weavers nest. Prepare to be inspired by the leopard's quick-footedness and determination, and the crocodiles patient approach. A thrilling ride packed with sudden strikes from Africa's Deadliest Ambush Hunters.

Then, while helping his dad on a farm call, Charles has a terrifying accident. The whole family rallies together to care for Charles and take care of the farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm

programme.title: Untamed Philippines

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Vital to the survival of many species, waterholes draw large concentrations of animals seeking to quench their thirst. But these wildlife hotspots are anything but peaceful oases — where there is water, Africa's deadliest are often nearby. From Nile crocodiles waiting beneath the surface for their parched prey to come to them to violent territorial disputes between giant hippo bulls, Africa's waterholes set the stage for some of the continent's greatest spectacles.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa is a land sculpted by time where animals have evolved complex weapons to arm them in the battle to live another day. An elephant's tusks can defend, or attack. An octopus uses camouflage to find food, or hide from an enemy. A Cape Fur Seal's speed and agility are valuable tools to catch a penguin, but ineffectual against a Great White Shark. A single hippopotamus holds a pride of twelve lions at bay with his sheer bulk, but backs down when faced with the piercing teeth of another hippo. With lethal weapons wielded by fearsome predators and prey, animals walk a precarious path, here among Africa's Deadliest.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they're locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India's lions prowl city streets. Familiar species and behaviors take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators.

programme.title: Juodoji rinka su M. Van Zeller
Ledo kelias
programme.desc: Norvegiška žiema toli gražu ne visiems padovanoja geras emocijas. Ledu padengti keliai kelia pavojų ir vieną po kito į šalikeles bloškia keliautojus. Sniege įstrigusias transporto priemones gali išvaduoti tik patyrę gelbėtojai, apsiginklavę specialia technika ir prietaisais. Gelbėjimo darbams tampant vis aktualesniems - Thordas, Bjornas, Jo Rogeris investuoja į naują techniką ir tikisi verslo suklestėjimo.

programme.title: Tucci Italijoje
programme.desc: Amerikiečių aktorius Stanley Tucci - vienas įvairiapusiškiausių žmonių Holivude. Iš Italijos kilęs vyras kino filmuose nesunkiai gali persikūnyti į žudiką, aukštosios mados dizainerį, linksmą sutuoktinį, landų žurnalistą, piktą žmogų ar keistuolį. Už filmavimo aikštelės ribų - jis gyvenimu besidžiaugiantis žmogus, su puikiu humoro jausmu ir didžiule meile gardžiam maistui. Tad ne nuostabu, kad jis kviečia žiūrovus atrasti tikrąją Italiją. Italijos regionų išskirtinumą, kuris geriausiai atsiskleidžia ruošiamuose patiekaluose. Stanley mėgaujasi maisto meniškumu vaizdingoje Toskanoje, aplanko Florenciją ir Sieną. Pasineria į kulinarinio kūrybiškumo dvasią Renesanso gimtinėje. Italijos pramoninėje šiaurėje Stanley tyrinėja novatorišką virtuvę ir futuristinį ūkininkavimą. Italijos vokiškai kalbančioje šiaurėje Stanley tyrinėja dvigubą kultūrinį tapatumą per šieno sriubą, slidinėjimą Dirndlio dieną, polentą kalnų šlaituose ir žvejybą ledyninėse upėse, ir tyrinėja, kaip istorinė pasienio įtampa formavo vietos virtuvę ir kultūrą. Šiame nelygiame regione Stanley tyrinėja, kaip reljefas formuoja maisto kultūrą. Jis kepa avieną ant grotelių avių ūkyje, mėgaujasi prancūziško stiliaus sekmadienio pietumis ir atskleidžia saldžią konfeti istoriją, atskleisdamas netikėtų kulinarinių malonumų.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

The deranged X sniffs out the fighting penguins, capturing them and hauling them off to the pokey. Can they rediscover the teamwork they had forsaken in order to escape? The penguins need his hypercute powers to knock Alice out and disengage her new zoo security system. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

Un metodo illegale di cui sono vittime anche privati cittadini. Sulla vicenda di Edward Snowden e' stato girato anche il documentario "Citizenfour", premiato con l'Oscar.

Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

programme.title: Speciale: Nord Sud Ovest Est, Extended
programme.desc: Un racconto corale dietro le quinte della serie. Attori, registi e capi reparto svelano il set, le scelte creative e il successo del progetto (Versione Extended).

programme.title: Free Willy: Un amico da salvare
programme.desc: L'incredibile storia d'amicizia tra un ragazzino ribelle e un'orca. Incaricato della pulizia di un acquario, Jesse fa amicizia con Willy, un'orca capace di mirabolanti esibizioni.

programme.title: I Goonies
programme.desc: Richard Donner firma una memorabile avventura ideata e prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Un gruppo di ragazzi trova una mappa che conduce al leggendario tesoro di un pirata.

programme.title: Vicky e il suo cucciolo
programme.desc: Toccante storia di amicizia sui monti del Cantal. Dopo la morte della madre, la piccola Victoria si e' chiusa nel mutismo. Un cucciolo di lupo le restituira' la voce e il sorriso.

programme.title: Paddington 2
programme.desc: Seconda avventura per l'orso pasticcione affiancato da Hugh Grant. Paddington insegue il misterioso ladro che ha rubato un antico libro destinato alla zia Lucy.

programme.title: Tom & Jerry
programme.desc: Tra animazione e live action, le origini di una storica rivalita'. Il topo Jerry giunge in un hotel di New York per assistere a un matrimonio. Per sbarazzarsene, viene assunto il gatto Tom.

programme.title: Viaggio al centro della Terra
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser nel remake di un classico degli anni 50. Tre esploratori si inoltrano sotto la superficie terrestre alla scoperta di un regno sconosciuto, abitato da minacciose creature.

programme.title: Minions
programme.desc: Dagli autori di "Cattivissimo me", lo spin-off che ripercorre la storia dei buffi personaggi, sempre alla ricerca di un cattivo da servire: dalla Preistoria fino alla Londra degli anni 60.

programme.title: Minions 2 - Come Gru diventa cattivissimo
programme.desc: Grande successo per il quinto capitolo del franchise Illumination con le amate creature gialle. Los Angeles, anni '70: l'adolescente Gru cresce in perfidia e sogna di entrare nei Malefici 6.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd e Sigourney Weaver nel sequel della commedia cult anni 80. Gli Acchiappafantasmi affrontano una forza maligna che ha invaso i sotterranei di New York.

programme.title: Megamind
programme.desc: Allegra parodia del mondo dei supereroi in un gioiello d'animazione DreamWorks. Annoiato dalla mancanza di un rivale, Megamind ne crea uno grazie al dna del nemico sconfitto, Metroman.

programme.title: Un bel giorno
programme.desc: Nuova commedia di successo per Fabio De Luigi e Virginia Raffaele. Tommaso, vedovo con quattro figlie, conosce Lara. L'incontro può cambiare tutto, ma entrambi nascondono qualcosa.

programme.title: Pedro galletto coraggioso: Missione Africa
programme.desc: Avventuroso sequel animato con il simpatico pennuto. Pedro e Di sono i genitori di due piccole uova dorate, che vengono rapite e portate in Africa dalla cattivissima Duchessa.

programme.title: Speciale: Nord Sud Ovest Est, Extended

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un altro emozionante capolavoro d'animazione. Hiccup, figlio di un capo vichingo, affronta il drago che minaccia la sua tribu' ma finisce per stringerci amicizia.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd e Sigourney Weaver nel sequel della commedia cult anni 80. Gli Acchiappafantasmi affrontano una forza maligna che ha invaso i sotterranei di New York.

programme.title: Hook - Capitan Uncino
programme.desc: Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman e Julia Roberts in un film di Steven Spielberg. Peter, ormai adulto, deve tornare sull’Isola che non c'e' per ritrovare i suoi figli, rapiti da Capitan Uncino.

programme.title: Il gatto con gli stivali
programme.desc: Il celebre felino e' il protagonista dello spin-off della saga di Shrek. Dopo una rapina finita male, l'amicizia fra Gatto e Humpty Dumpty si e' rotta, ma il destino li fara' rincontrare.

programme.title: Un bel giorno
programme.desc: Nuova commedia di successo per Fabio De Luigi e Virginia Raffaele. Tommaso, vedovo con quattro figlie, conosce Lara. L'incontro può cambiare tutto, ma entrambi nascondono qualcosa.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinita'. La sua missione da predestinato e' fermare la guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra.

programme.title: C'è tempo
programme.desc: Stefano Fresi in una commedia 'on the road' di Walter Veltroni. Alla morte del padre, un quarantenne 'osservatore di arcobaleni' scopre di avere un fratellastro minorenne.

programme.title: King - Un cucciolo da salvare
programme.desc: Avventurosa pellicola animalista. Due ragazzini francesi, Ines e Alex, aiutano un cucciolo di leone destinato alla tratta dei bracconieri a ritornare nel suo habitat in Africa.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un altro emozionante capolavoro d'animazione. Hiccup, figlio di un capo vichingo, affronta il drago che minaccia la sua tribu' ma finisce per stringerci amicizia.

programme.title: Z La formica
programme.desc: Spettacolari avventure in un gioiello d'animazione della Dreamworks. Per fare colpo sulla Principessa Bala, Z si finge formica-soldato e si trova coinvolto nella guerra contro le termiti.

programme.title: Unicorni
programme.desc: Blu è un bambino che sogna di interpretare la Sirenetta. Suo padre Lucio non sa come affrontare le richieste del figlio mentre sua moglie, Elena, tende ad assecondare le richieste di Blu. Il gruppo di "Genitori Unicorni" sostiene la famiglia.

programme.title: Hook - Capitan Uncino
programme.desc: Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman e Julia Roberts in un film di Steven Spielberg. Peter, ormai adulto, deve tornare sull’Isola che non c'e' per ritrovare i suoi figli, rapiti da Capitan Uncino.

programme.title: King - Un cucciolo da salvare
programme.desc: Avventurosa pellicola animalista. Due ragazzini francesi, Ines e Alex, aiutano un cucciolo di leone destinato alla tratta dei bracconieri a ritornare nel suo habitat in Africa.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer 2
programme.desc: Sequel del capolavoro d'animazione Dreamworks. Il giovane vichingo Hiccup e il suo fedele amico Sdentato difendono il loro villaggio da un temibile drago rinnegato.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinita'. La sua missione da predestinato e' fermare la guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra.

programme.title: Giu' per il tubo
programme.desc: Avventure e sfrenata comicita' in un'animazione targata DreamWorks. Londra: per liberarsi di un roditore dei bassifondi, un raffinato topo 'da salotto' finisce nelle fogne di Ratropolis.

programme.title: Paddington
programme.desc: Moderna favola natalizia tratta dai libri di Michael Bond. Un orso peruviano vola a Londra alla ricerca di una vita migliore. L'amorevole famiglia Brown fara' avverare il suo sogno.

programme.title: Willy Wonka e la fabbrica di cioccolato
programme.desc: Gene Wilder in un inno alla fantasia, dal romanzo di Roald Dahl. Lo stravagante Willy Wonka accompagna cinque bambini in un tour all'interno della sua inaccessibile fabbrica di dolciumi.

programme.title: Rock Dog 2
programme.desc: Animazione rockeggiante Sky Original. Bodi e la sua band sono ormai gli idoli di Snow Mountain. Quando un impresario li scrittura per un tour scopriranno che la fama ha un prezzo.

programme.title: Biancaneve e il cacciatore
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart, Chris Hemsworth e Charlize Theron nella rilettura della famosa fiaba. La crudele regina incarica un cacciatore di uccidere la figliastra Biancaneve, in fuga verso il bosco.

programme.title: Ritorno al futuro
programme.desc: Michael J.Fox nel primo capitolo della trilogia cult di Robert Zemeckis. Anni '80: con una macchina del tempo, l'adolescente Marty McFly finisce nel 1955 e incontra i suoi futuri genitori.

programme.title: Paddington
programme.desc: Moderna favola natalizia tratta dai libri di Michael Bond. Un orso peruviano vola a Londra alla ricerca di una vita migliore. L'amorevole famiglia Brown fara' avverare il suo sogno.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer 2
programme.desc: Sequel del capolavoro d'animazione Dreamworks. Il giovane vichingo Hiccup e il suo fedele amico Sdentato difendono il loro villaggio da un temibile drago rinnegato.

programme.title: Capitan Sciabola e il diamante magico
programme.desc: Avventura animata nel mondo dei pirati. A caccia di un diamante fatato, Capitan Sciabola incontrerà uno scaltro orfanello, un giovane corsaro e un'avventurosa e intraprendente fanciulla.

programme.title: La piccola Amelie
programme.desc: Amélie è una bambina belga nata in Giappone. Grazie al suo amico, Nishio San, il mondo è pieno di avventure e scoperte. Il giorno del suo terzo compleanno, un evento cambia il corso della sua vita.

programme.title: Rock Dog 2
programme.desc: Animazione rockeggiante Sky Original. Bodi e la sua band sono ormai gli idoli di Snow Mountain. Quando un impresario li scrittura per un tour scopriranno che la fama ha un prezzo.

programme.title: Willy Wonka e la fabbrica di cioccolato
programme.desc: Gene Wilder in un inno alla fantasia, dal romanzo di Roald Dahl. Lo stravagante Willy Wonka accompagna cinque bambini in un tour all'interno della sua inaccessibile fabbrica di dolciumi.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer - Il mondo nascosto
programme.desc: Terzo toccante capitolo della trilogia di successo targata DreamWorks. La minaccia di Grimmel il Grifagno costringe Hiccup e Sdentato a partire verso un luogo leggendario.

programme.title: Lego Batman - Il film
programme.desc: Animazione digitale e mattoncini Lego si combinano di nuovo per un’avventura targata DC. Batman si allea con la Justice League per sconfiggere i supercattivi capitanati da Joker.

programme.title: Biancaneve e il cacciatore
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart, Chris Hemsworth e Charlize Theron nella rilettura della famosa fiaba. La crudele regina incarica un cacciatore di uccidere la figliastra Biancaneve, in fuga verso il bosco.

programme.title: La strada per El Dorado
programme.desc: Viaggio nel Nuovo Mondo in una pellicola di animazione targata Dreamworks. 1519: fuggiti da un galeone spagnolo, due imbroglioni cercano il leggendario tesoro della città di El Dorado.

programme.title: Ghostbusters - Acchiappafantasmi
programme.desc: Cult assoluto della commedia anni 80 con Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd e Harold Ramis. New York: tre scienziati fondano un'agenzia che si occupa di catturare fantasmi e sfidano il demone Zuul.

programme.title: Rock Dog 3
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo animato, targato Sky Original, con il mastino tibetano amante del rock. Dopo aver girato il mondo, Bodi torna al suo villaggio e diventa il coach di una band femminile.

programme.title: Dolcissime
programme.desc: Delicata commedia di Francesco Ghiaccio. Tre ragazze derise per il loro aspetto cercano il riscatto in una gara di nuoto sincronizzato. Nel cast Vinicio Marchioni e Valeria Solarino.

programme.title: Inkheart - La leggenda di Cuore d'inchiostro
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

programme.desc: Il sapore del cinema classico in un'impeccabile spy-story sull'arte dell'inganno con Brad Pitt e Marion Cotillard, diretti da Robert Zemeckis. 1942: l'ufficiale franco-canadese Max Vatan e la militante della Resistenza francese Marianne Beausejour si innamorano dopo aver compiuto una missione: l'uccisione dell'ambasciatore tedesco a Casablanca. L'armonia della loro love story viene però incrinata dal sospetto: Max Vatan viene infatti informato dai suoi superiori che Marianne potrebbe essere una spia al soldo dei nazisti. Dallo sceneggiatore de "La promessa dell'assassino", Steven Knight.

programme.desc: Ingiustamente incarcerata per l'omicidio di un bambino, una donna fa della vendetta verso i veri colpevoli la sua ragione di vita.

programme.title: Il castello
programme.desc: Il premio Oscar Robert Redford, James Gandolfini e Mark Ruffalo in un solido dramma carcerario. Recluso in una prigione di massima sicurezza per aver disobbedito a un ordine, il generale Irving, eroe del Vietnam e del Golfo, non può condividere i metodi del direttore della prigione, un colonnello autoritario e crudele. In un continuo crescendo di violenze e ingiustizie scoppia la rivolta dei detenuti, che eleggono Irving come loro capo. La regia è di Rod Lurie, ex critico cinematografico, diplomato alla famosa Accademia Militare di West Point.

programme.desc: Naomi Watts in un thriller carico di suspense. Una psicologa infantile, vedova e con un figliastro paralizzato da accudire, affronta il caso della misteriosa sparizione di un bambino.

programme.title: The Conjuring - Il Caso Enfield
programme.desc: James Wan dirige Patrick Wilson e Vera Farmiga nel secondo capitolo della saga horror. I coniugi Warren cercano di proteggere una famiglia dagli spiriti che infestano la loro casa londinese.

programme.title: Schegge di paura
programme.desc: Richard Gere ed Edward Norton, premiato con il Golden Globe, in un classico thriller giudiziario. Un avvocato accetta di difendere gratis un chierichetto, un giovane schizofrenico affetto da personalita' multipla, accusato dell'omicidio dell'arcivescovo di Chicago. Le prove dell'accusa contro il ragazzo sono schiaccianti, ma la partita in tribunale e' tutta da giocare, anche perche' la verita' e' molto piu' complessa e sorprendente. E soprattutto non e' quella che sembra. Film d'esordio per Norton, che ottenne anche la nomination agli Oscar come miglior attore non protagonista.

programme.title: Companion
programme.desc: Sophie Thatcher e Jack Quaid nel pazzesco fanta-thriller di Drew Hancock. Nella villa di un miliardario, inventore di una rivoluzionaria app per incontri, un gruppo di ragazzi viene travolto da una serie di imprevedibili eventi, fra insospettabili robot e un malloppo da rubare.

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Carlo Lavagna dirige un thriller ambientato nel buio dei boschi. Una madre severa costringe le figlie a vivere da recluse in un hotel abbandonato per proteggerle da una scioccante verita'.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: Due uomini trovano la più grande pepita d'oro mai scoperta e devono trovare un modo per dissotterrarla, ma il dubbio e l'avidità iniziano a farsi strada mentre i due mettono in atto il loro piano.

programme.title: High Ground
programme.desc: Un misterioso nuovo detenuto finisce nella prigione di una città di frontiera. Lo sceriffo del posto si ritrova a dover affrontare l'ira di un brutale cartello della droga, che agisce senza pietà.

programme.title: The Shift
programme.desc: Alessandro Tonda, nel suo esordio alla regia, dirige una pellicola ad alta tensione con Clotilde Hesme e Adamo Dionisi. Due studenti musulmani compiono un attentato in una scuola di Bruxelles. I paramedici ne caricano uno sull’ambulanza, ignari della sua cintura esplosiva.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: Naomi Watts in un thriller carico di suspense. Una psicologa infantile, vedova e con un figliastro paralizzato da accudire, affronta il caso della misteriosa sparizione di un bambino.

programme.title: Le Notti Di Salem
programme.desc: Tornato alla sua città natale nella speranza di riprendere a scrivere, Ben Mears scopre che è dominata dai vampiri e che l'unico modo per liberarla è entrare a far parte di una banda che sta tentando di sconfiggere queste creature.

programme.title: Trespass - Sequestrati
programme.desc: Thriller di Joel Schumacher con Nicolas Cage e Nicole Kidman. Una banda di criminali sequestra 2 coniugi nella loro villa. La lunga notte di violenza farà affiorare segreti inconfessabili.

programme.title: The Twin - L'altro volto del male
programme.desc: Teresa Palmer in un thriller dalle atmosfere suggestive. Dopo la morte del figlio, una coppia si trasferisce in Finlandia con il fratello gemello; ma quest'ultimo si comporta in modo strano.

programme.title: Companion
programme.desc: Sophie Thatcher e Jack Quaid nel pazzesco fanta-thriller di Drew Hancock. Nella villa di un miliardario, inventore di una rivoluzionaria app per incontri, un gruppo di ragazzi viene travolto da una serie di imprevedibili eventi, fra insospettabili robot e un malloppo da rubare.

programme.title: Les Mise'rables
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 3 Golden Globe al dramma musicale con Hugh Jackman, Anne Hathaway e Russell Crowe, dal romanzo di Victor Hugo. Un ex detenuto si riscostruisce una nuova vita sotto falso nome.

programme.title: Speciale: Nord Sud Ovest Est
programme.desc: Un racconto corale dietro le quinte della serie. Attori, registi e capi reparto svelano il set, le scelte creative e il successo del progetto.

programme.title: Quello che non so di te
programme.desc: Commedia romantica, dal romanzo di Jenny B. Jones. Sul volo per l'Irlanda, una giovane violinista newyorkese incontra un divo del cinema. Benche' molto diversi, tra i due nascera' l'amore.

programme.title: Corro da te
programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige Pierfrancesco Favino e Miriam Leone in una commedia brillante e dissacrante. Gianni e' un seduttore seriale, ma l'incontro con Chiara cambiera' tutto.

programme.title: The Good House
programme.desc: Sigourney Weaver e Kevin Kline nel film dal romanzo di Ann Leary. Una vecchia fiamma che si riaccende costringe una valida agente immobiliare ad affrontare i suoi problemi di alcolismo.

programme.title: Innamorarsi
programme.desc: Un'intensa storia romantica con la straordinaria coppia da Oscar, Robert De Niro-Meryl Streep. Lui ingegnere, lei disegnatrice pubblicitaria, si incontrano casualmente in una libreria di New York, alla vigilia di Natale. Si rivedono poi ogni giorno, sul treno per andare a lavoro. Entrambi sposati, si innamorano sia pure tra mille riserve che alla fine prendono il sopravvento. Tra loro cala il silenzio, ma il destino li fara' incontrare ancora un anno piu' tardi... David di Donatello alla Streep come miglior attrice straniera.

programme.title: Il dio dell'amore
programme.desc: In una realtà sospesa tra sogno e quotidiano, il film esplora i confini del sentimento più puro. Un viaggio onirico e poetico che mette a nudo la fragilità umana di fronte alla forza travolgente del destino.

programme.title: Il filo nascosto
programme.desc: Oscar ai costumi per la pellicola di Paul Thomas Anderson con un formidabile Daniel Day-Lewis. Londra, anni 50: la vita di un rinomato stilista viene turbata dall'infatuazione per una donna.

programme.title: Tre amiche
programme.desc: Un cast al femminile capitanato da Camille Cottin in un film presentato in concorso a Venezia. Le dinamiche sentimentali di 3 quarantenni vengono sconvolte da un evento inaspettato.

programme.title: Come fratelli
programme.desc: Due amiche rimangono incinte contemporaneamente e muoiono in un incidente. I loro rispettivi mariti, lasciati soli ad affrontare la sfida di essere padri e vedovi, decidono di unire i loro sforzi per crescere i figli.

programme.title: Quello che non so di te
programme.desc: Commedia romantica, dal romanzo di Jenny B. Jones. Sul volo per l'Irlanda, una giovane violinista newyorkese incontra un divo del cinema. Benche' molto diversi, tra i due nascera' l'amore.

programme.title: Rifkin's Festival
programme.desc: Woody Allen dirige Gina Gershon e Louis Garrel in una commedia che racconta le vicissitudini di un ex insegnante di cinema, al seguito della moglie al Festival di San Sebastian.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di grigio
programme.desc: Eros e romanticismo per Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan, dal romanzo di E. L. James. Una studentessa viene sedotta da un uomo ricco e misterioso, che la coinvolge in un rapporto trasgressivo.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di nero
programme.desc: Tornano Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan nelle avventure sentimental-erotiche tratte dal secondo capitolo della bollente saga letteraria di E. L. James. Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di rosso
programme.desc: Anastasia e Christian, finalmente sposi, credono di essersi lasciati alle spalle il passato, ma un nuovo pericolo minaccia il loro legame.

programme.title: La mia Africa
programme.desc: Sette Oscar all’intenso dramma di Sydney Pollack con Meryl Streep e Robert Redford, tratto dall’autobiografia di Karen Blixen. La scrittrice ripercorre gli anni passati in Kenya.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Garry Marshall (Pretty Woman) dirige una commedia con Jennifer Aniston, Kate Hudson e Julia Roberts. La festa della mamma intreccia i destini di 4 donne fra amori e segreti da nascondere.

programme.title: The Colour Room
programme.desc: Phoebe Dynevor nel biopic targato Sky Original, diretto da Claire McCarthy. La storia della rivoluzionaria artista della ceramica Clarice Cliff, una delle prime esponenti dell'Art Deco.

programme.title: Secret Love
programme.desc: Dramma romantico con Josh O'Connor, Odessa Young, Olivia Colman e Colin Firth. Inghilterra, 1924: una cameriera incontra di nascosto il suo amante, che sta per sposare un'altra donna.

programme.title: Shelter
programme.desc: Jennifer Connelly e Anthony Mackie in un toccante film di Paul Bettany. Provenienti da mondi diversi, i destini di Hannah e Tahir si incrociano per le strade di New York.

programme.title: Come fratelli

programme.title: Tumbledown
programme.desc: Rebecca Hall e Jason Sudeikis fra i paesaggi dei Maine in una commedia sul senso della perdita. Hannah, la giovane vedova dell'acclamato folk singer Hunter Miles, sta scrivendo la biografia del defunto marito nel tentativo di elaborare il lutto che la tormenta. Alla stesura collabora Andrew, uno scrittore e professore universitario che cerchera' di incrinare il guscio di rabbia e solitudine in cui Hannah si e' rinchiusa. Non solo per ultimare il libro, ma soprattutto per aiutarla a rifarsi una vita. Opera prima di Sean Mewshaw, assistente alla regia di Martin Scorsese in "Gangs of New York".

programme.desc: A causa della sua dipendenza dal sesso, Darla perde il lavoro. Bailey viene scaricato dalla fidanzatina del liceo. I due iniziano una terapia nella quale Darla ricostruisce il suo passato sessuale.

programme.title: The Land of Dreams
programme.desc: Musical nella New York degli anni 20 con Katsiaryna Shulha, Edoardo Pesce e Stefano Fresi. Una giovane emigrata lavora come lavapiatti e sogna di cantare. Un incontro speciale la aiutera'.

programme.title: Una proposta per dire si'
programme.desc: Amy Adams e Matthew Goode in una commedia romantica ambientata in Irlanda. Anna vuole approfittare di un'antica tradizione per convincere finalmente il suo fidanzato a sposarla.

programme.title: Ti Odio, Ti Lascio, Ti...
programme.desc: Commedia romantica con Vince Vaughn e Jennifer Aniston. Dopo l'ennesimo diverbio, Gary e Brooke decidono di lasciarsi ma nessuno dei due e' intenzionato ad abbandonare il tetto coniugale.

programme.title: Book of Love
programme.desc: Sam Claflin in una commedia romantica targata Sky Original. In Messico per promuovere il suo libro uno scrittore inglese scopre che la traduttrice lo ha trasformato in un romanzo erotico.

programme.title: Il tenente ottomano
programme.desc: L'amore in tempo di guerra in un dramma con Ben Kingsley e Josh Hartnett. Alla vigilia della Grande Guerra, un'infermiera lascia l'America per una missione medica nell'Impero turco.

programme.desc: Marilyn Lima e Nicolas Duvauchelle in una magica avventura su un amore impossibile. Un cantante si prende cura di una sirena ferita, ma cade vittima della sua voce ammaliante.

Dopo la fine del conflitto Gianni, Antonio e Nicola (Stefano Satta Flores) hanno preso strade diverse: Antonio fa il portantino e Nicola il professore, mentre Gianni è l’unico dei tre che è riuscito a fare carriera. Dopo molti anni, per caso, i tre si incontrano nuovamente. Sceneggiatura dello stesso Scola, con Age & Scarpelli, breve cameo di Vittorio De Sica, scomparso prima dell’uscita del film nelle sale.

programme.desc: Dal creatore di "Succession", una pungente satira targata HBO con Steve Carell e Jason Schwartzman. 4 amici milionari si riuniscono sullo sfondo di una crisi globale.

programme.desc: Una giovane donna, tecnico delle luci per una compagnia teatrale che sta allestendo "Le baccanti" di Euripide, deve gestire il ritorno nella sua vita del padre malato e fare i conti con i dubbi esistenziali che la assillano.

programme.title: Io e Lulù
programme.desc: Road movie di e con Channing Tatum, alla sua opera prima. Un ex ranger dell'esercito americano deve portare Lulu', cagnolina esperta in missioni belliche, al funerale del suo padrone.

programme.desc: Giovanni Virgilio narra un pezzo di storia siciliana, con Alessio Vassallo, Stella Egitto e Nino Frassica. Dopo un'infanzia segnata dalla guerra, un uomo diventa l'onesto sindaco del paese.

programme.desc: Dall'omonimo romanzo, Chloé Zhao dirige Jessie Buckley, premiata con l'Oscar, e Paul Mescal nel film che racconta uno degli episodi più tragici nella vita dei coniugi Shakespeare.

programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.
